messages.name: Nadia Ferreira
messages.text: Hi Tom, the projector in Room 4B isn't turning on. The client presentation starts at 10.

messages.name: Tom Becker
messages.text: Did you check the power strip under the table? It has its own switch.

messages.name: Tom Becker
messages.text: OK. I'll bring the portable one from the IT office. Give me five minutes.

questions.prompt: What problem does Ms. Ferreira have?
options: A meeting room is already booked.
A piece of equipment is not working.
questions.evidence: the projector in Room 4B isn't turning on
questions.explanation: Mme Ferreira écrit que le projecteur ne s'allume pas : « a piece of equipment is not working » reformule ce problème de manière générale.
questions.traps: Le TOEIC remplace souvent le mot exact (projector) par une catégorie générale (a piece of equipment).
questions.takeaway: Les bonnes réponses sont souvent des paraphrases plus générales que le texte.

questions.prompt: At 9:16, what does Ms. Ferreira most likely mean when she writes, "You're a lifesaver"?
options: She is worried about Mr. Becker's safety.
She wants Mr. Becker to lead the presentation.
She is grateful for Mr. Becker's help.
She thinks the problem is serious.
questions.evidence: You're a lifesaver.
questions.explanation: M. Becker propose d'apporter un projecteur portable dans cinq minutes ; « You're a lifesaver » (tu me sauves la vie) est une expression de reconnaissance.
questions.traps: (A) prend l'expression au sens littéral : piège classique des questions d'intention.
questions.takeaway: Questions « what does X mean » : interprète l'expression dans son contexte, jamais littéralement.

docs.title: NOTICE TO TENANTS — Harbor View Office Tower
docs.body:
The underground parking garage will be closed for resurfacing from Saturday, June 7, through Monday, June 9. During this period, tenants may park free of charge at the Elm Street municipal lot, located two blocks east of the building. Please display your tenant permit on your dashboard.

A shuttle will run between the lot and the main entrance every 15 minutes from 7 A.M. to 7 P.M. on Monday.

Questions should be directed to the building management office at extension 210.

questions.prompt: Why will the parking garage be closed?
questions.evidence: closed for resurfacing
questions.explanation: « Resurfacing » signifie refaire le revêtement : le garage ferme pour des travaux sur sa surface.
questions.takeaway: Resurface = refaire le revêtement ; repair work = travaux de réparation.

questions.prompt: What is indicated about the shuttle service?
options: It will operate on only one day.
questions.evidence: every 15 minutes from 7 A.M. to 7 P.M. on Monday
questions.explanation: La navette circule seulement le lundi (« on Monday »), alors que la fermeture dure trois jours : elle fonctionne donc un seul jour.
questions.traps: Le permis concerne le stationnement, pas la navette ; la fréquence est de 15 minutes, pas 30.
questions.takeaway: Repère les limitations (only, on Monday) qui rendent une réponse plus précise.

docs.title: Bellamy's Print & Copy — Spring Offer
docs.body:
Get 20% off all business card orders of 500 cards or more until April 30. Choose from 40 professional templates or upload your own design. Orders placed before noon are ready for pickup the next business day. Free delivery within the city for orders over $75.

Present this coupon in store or enter code SPRING20 online. Cannot be combined with other offers.

questions.prompt: What must customers do to receive the discount?
options: Use one of the store's templates
questions.evidence: orders of 500 cards or more
questions.explanation: La réduction de 20 % s'applique aux commandes de 500 cartes ou plus : « at least 500 » = « 500 or more ».
questions.traps: 75 $ est le seuil de la livraison gratuite, et midi celui du retrait le lendemain : ce sont d'autres conditions.
questions.takeaway: « At least » = « or more » = au moins.

questions.prompt: What is NOT mentioned as a service offered by Bellamy's?
questions.explanation: Le texte mentionne les modèles personnalisés (upload your own design), le retrait le lendemain et la livraison gratuite au-delà de 75 $. Aucune consultation de design n'est proposée.
questions.traps: Pour une question NOT, élimine une à une les options présentes dans le texte.
questions.takeaway: Questions NOT : vérifie chaque option dans le texte ; la réponse est celle qu'on ne trouve pas.

docs.subject: Your first day at Solenne Biotech
docs.body:
Dear Mr. Morel,

We are delighted that you have accepted our offer for the position of Quality Control Analyst. Your first day will be Monday, September 1. Please report to the reception desk on the ground floor at 8:30 A.M., where a member of our team will meet you.

On your first morning, you will attend an orientation session covering laboratory safety and our data management policies. In the afternoon, you will meet your supervisor, Dr. Anke Vogel, who will introduce you to the rest of the team.

Please bring a valid photo ID and the signed copy of your employment contract. If you have not yet returned the tax form attached to our previous e-mail, please complete it before your start date.

Best regards,
Priya Raman

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
options: To offer Mr. Morel a position
To request Mr. Morel's tax information
To give Mr. Morel information about his first day
questions.evidence: Your first day will be Monday, September 1.
questions.explanation: L'offre a déjà été acceptée ; le mail donne le programme du premier jour (horaire, lieu, formation, documents à apporter).
questions.traps: (A) : l'offre est déjà acceptée. (C) : le formulaire fiscal est un détail secondaire, pas l'objectif.
questions.takeaway: L'objectif d'un document = l'idée qui couvre l'ensemble, pas un détail.

questions.prompt: What will Mr. Morel do on the afternoon of September 1?
questions.evidence: who will introduce you to the rest of the team
questions.explanation: L'après-midi, il rencontre sa superviseure, qui le présente au reste de l'équipe, c'est-à-dire à ses collègues.
questions.traps: La formation sécurité a lieu le matin (« On your first morning »).
questions.takeaway: Attention aux repères temporels : morning / afternoon.

questions.prompt: What is Mr. Morel asked to bring?
questions.evidence: Please bring a valid photo ID
questions.explanation: « A valid photo ID » (pièce d'identité avec photo) est reformulé par « proof of identity ».
questions.takeaway: ID = identification document = proof of identity.

docs.title: Café Lumen Opens Second Location
docs.body:
Café Lumen, the popular coffee shop known for its locally roasted beans, opened its second location on Dufort Avenue last week. Owner Mireille Caron said the new space is nearly twice the size of the original café on Quai Street and includes a small room that customers can reserve for meetings. [1]

Caron started the business six years ago with a single espresso machine and two employees. Today, she employs 23 people. [2]

The Dufort Avenue café also features a roasting area behind a glass wall, allowing customers to watch the beans being prepared. [3] Caron plans to offer weekend workshops on coffee tasting beginning next month. [4]

questions.prompt: What is indicated about the new location?
options: It has a space that can be booked.
It is smaller than the original café.
It is located on Quai Street.
It is open only on weekends.
questions.evidence: includes a small room that customers can reserve for meetings
questions.explanation: Le nouveau café comprend une petite salle que les clients peuvent réserver : « booked » = « reserved ».
questions.traps: Il est presque deux fois plus grand ; Quai Street est l'adresse du premier café.
questions.takeaway: Reserve = book ; twice the size = deux fois plus grand.

questions.prompt: The word "features" in paragraph 3, line 1, is closest in meaning to
questions.evidence: also features a roasting area
questions.explanation: « The café features a roasting area » = le café comporte / possède un espace de torréfaction. Le sens est « includes ».
questions.traps: « Highlights » (met en valeur) correspond à un autre sens de « feature », qui ne convient pas ici.
questions.takeaway: Feature (verbe) = comporter, présenter ; vérifie toujours le sens en contexte.

questions.prompt: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "Places are limited, so interested participants should sign up early."
questions.explanation: « Places » et « participants » renvoient aux ateliers de dégustation annoncés juste avant la position [4] : on s'inscrit à un atelier.
questions.traps: Les positions [1] et [3] parlent de la salle et de l'espace de torréfaction, pas d'une activité avec des participants.
questions.takeaway: Insertion : les mots-clés de la phrase (participants, sign up) doivent faire écho à la phrase précédente.

docs.title: Hotel Arcadia — Guest Comment Card
docs.body: The room was spotless and the staff at the front desk were extremely helpful when my flight was delayed and I arrived after midnight. However, the Wi-Fi connection in my room was unreliable, which made it difficult to prepare for my presentation. I ended up working in the lobby, where the signal was much stronger. Breakfast was excellent, though I would suggest opening the restaurant earlier than 7 A.M. for guests attending early meetings.

questions.prompt: Why did Mr. Osei stay at Hotel Arcadia?
questions.evidence: Business conference
questions.explanation: Le motif du séjour indiqué est « Business conference » : un événement professionnel.
questions.takeaway: Lis aussi les champs des formulaires : ils contiennent souvent la réponse.

questions.prompt: What problem did Mr. Osei experience?
options: He could not get a reliable Internet connection in his room.
The front desk was closed when he arrived.
questions.evidence: the Wi-Fi connection in my room was unreliable
questions.explanation: Le Wi-Fi de la chambre était peu fiable ; il a dû travailler dans le hall.
questions.traps: La chambre était impeccable (spotless) et l'accueil très serviable malgré son arrivée tardive.
questions.takeaway: Unreliable = peu fiable ; spotless = impeccable.

questions.prompt: What does Mr. Osei suggest?
questions.evidence: opening the restaurant earlier than 7 A.M.
questions.explanation: Il suggère d'ouvrir le restaurant avant 7 h pour le petit-déjeuner, au profit des clients ayant des réunions tôt.
questions.takeaway: Les suggestions sont souvent introduites par « I would suggest / I recommend ».

docs.title: MEMO
docs.subtitle: To: All sales staff — From: Gareth Lowe, Finance Director — Date: January 9 — Re: New expense reporting procedure
docs.body:
Effective February 1, all expense reports must be submitted through the ExpensePoint mobile app rather than on paper. The app allows you to photograph receipts and submit claims directly from your phone, which should significantly shorten reimbursement times. Claims submitted through the app will be reimbursed within five business days, compared with the current average of three weeks.

Training sessions on the app will be held on January 20 and January 27. Attendance at one of the sessions is mandatory for all staff who travel for work. Paper forms will no longer be accepted after February 1, except for claims relating to trips completed before that date.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the memo?
options: To request feedback on an app
To introduce a new finance director
To announce a change in procedure
questions.evidence: all expense reports must be submitted through the ExpensePoint mobile app rather than on paper
questions.explanation: Le mémo annonce le passage des notes de frais papier à une application : c'est un changement de procédure.
questions.takeaway: Re: (objet) d'un mémo résume souvent le but du document.

questions.prompt: What is one benefit of the new system?
options: Receipts will no longer be required.
Employees will be reimbursed more quickly.
questions.evidence: will be reimbursed within five business days
questions.explanation: Les remboursements passeront de trois semaines en moyenne à cinq jours ouvrés : les employés seront remboursés plus vite.
questions.traps: (B) est faux : on photographie toujours les reçus. (D) est faux : la formation est obligatoire (mandatory).
questions.takeaway: Mandatory = obligatoire ; reimburse = rembourser.

questions.prompt: According to the memo, when can paper forms be used after February 1?
options: When the app is not working
For claims under a certain amount
For trips that ended before February 1
Until the training sessions are completed
questions.evidence: except for claims relating to trips completed before that date
questions.explanation: Après le 1er février, le papier n'est accepté que pour les déplacements terminés avant cette date.
questions.traps: Les autres options sont plausibles dans la vie réelle mais ne figurent pas dans le texte.
questions.takeaway: « Except for » signale une exception : souvent l'objet d'une question de détail.

docs.title: Customer Review — TrailMate X2 Backpack ★★★★☆
docs.subtitle: Posted by J. Whitfield
docs.body:
I bought the TrailMate X2 for a two-week trip that combined client meetings in Toronto with a few days of hiking. The laptop compartment is well padded and easily fits my 15-inch computer, and the bag looks professional enough to bring to client offices.

My only complaint concerns the side pockets, which are too shallow to hold a standard water bottle securely. I lost one on the trail on my second day. Customer service responded quickly when I mentioned this and sent me a discount code for a bottle holder accessory.

Overall, a versatile bag that I would recommend to anyone who travels for both work and leisure.

questions.prompt: Why did the reviewer buy the backpack?
options: To replace a damaged laptop bag
To use on a trip involving work and recreation
To give as a gift to a client
questions.evidence: combined client meetings in Toronto with a few days of hiking
questions.explanation: Le voyage combinait rendez-vous clients (travail) et randonnée (loisir) : « work and recreation ».
questions.takeaway: Leisure = recreation = loisirs.

questions.prompt: What does the reviewer criticize about the backpack?
options: The padding of the laptop compartment
questions.evidence: too shallow to hold a standard water bottle securely
questions.explanation: Les poches latérales sont trop peu profondes pour tenir une bouteille : c'est un problème de taille des poches.
questions.traps: (D) est un point positif du texte (« well padded »).
questions.takeaway: Shallow = peu profond ; complaint = reproche.

questions.prompt: What did the company do after the reviewer contacted it?
options: It sent a new water bottle.
It offered a reduced price on an accessory.
questions.evidence: sent me a discount code for a bottle holder accessory
questions.explanation: Le service client a envoyé un code de réduction pour un porte-bouteille : un prix réduit sur un accessoire.
questions.traps: (C) reprend « water bottle » mais l'entreprise n'a pas envoyé de bouteille.
questions.takeaway: Méfie-toi des options qui recyclent les mots du texte avec un autre sens.

docs.title: Northgate Foods Announces Packaging Overhaul
docs.body:
LEEDS — Northgate Foods, one of the region's largest producers of ready-made meals, said on Monday that it will replace all plastic trays in its product line with recyclable cardboard by the end of next year. The company estimates that the change will eliminate roughly 1,200 tonnes of plastic waste annually.

The transition will take place in two phases. Beginning in March, the company's soup and salad ranges will switch to the new packaging. Its frozen meals, which require containers that can withstand very low temperatures, will follow once suppliers have finished testing a reinforced version of the cardboard trays.

"Our customers have been asking for this for years," said Chief Operating Officer Helen Strand. "We wanted to make sure the new packaging protects the food just as well as the old one before making the switch."

Northgate expects the new trays to cost about 8 percent more than plastic ones. However, Ms. Strand said the company does not plan to raise retail prices, as it expects to offset the increase through lower waste-disposal fees.

questions.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: A rise in the price of ready-made meals
The opening of a new food factory
A company's plan to change its packaging
A merger between two food producers
questions.evidence: replace all plastic trays in its product line with recyclable cardboard
questions.explanation: L'article porte sur le remplacement des barquettes en plastique par du carton recyclable.
questions.takeaway: Le premier paragraphe d'un article contient presque toujours l'idée principale.

questions.prompt: Why will frozen meals switch to the new packaging later than other products?
options: Their containers must meet special requirements.
questions.evidence: which require containers that can withstand very low temperatures
questions.explanation: Les plats surgelés exigent des barquettes résistant aux très basses températures ; une version renforcée est encore en test.
questions.takeaway: Withstand = résister à ; requirement = exigence.

questions.prompt: The word "offset" in paragraph 4, line 3, is closest in meaning to
questions.evidence: offset the increase
questions.explanation: L'entreprise compte « compenser » le surcoût de 8 % grâce à des frais de traitement des déchets plus faibles.
questions.takeaway: Offset = compenser, contrebalancer.

questions.prompt: What is suggested about Northgate's customers?
options: They prefer frozen meals to salads.
They were surveyed about the cardboard trays.
They have requested more environmentally friendly packaging.
questions.evidence: Our customers have been asking for this for years
questions.explanation: La directrice des opérations dit que les clients réclament ce changement (des emballages recyclables) depuis des années.
questions.traps: (A) est contredit : l'entreprise ne prévoit pas d'augmenter ses prix. (C) n'est mentionné nulle part.
questions.takeaway: Inférence : la réponse se déduit d'une phrase précise, sans extrapolation excessive.

messages.name: Ana Silva
messages.text: Quick update on the Hamburg trade fair. The organizers just confirmed our booth location: Hall 3, stand 3-118.

messages.name: Ben Kowalski
messages.text: Great. Is that near the main entrance? Last year we were stuck at the back of Hall 6.

messages.name: Ana Silva
messages.text: Right next to the north entrance, so we should get plenty of foot traffic.

messages.name: Chloé Martin
messages.text: Good news. What about the product samples? The shipment for last year's fair arrived a day late.

messages.name: Ana Silva
messages.text: I've booked the courier for October 2, a full week before setup day.

messages.name: Ben Kowalski
messages.text: Perfect. Chloé, can you finalize the brochures?

messages.name: Chloé Martin
messages.text: Already at the printer. I'll pick them up Thursday.

messages.name: Ben Kowalski
messages.text: Then I think we're in good shape.

questions.prompt: What are the writers mainly discussing?
options: The hiring of a courier company
The design of a new product
questions.evidence: Quick update on the Hamburg trade fair.
questions.explanation: Toute la discussion porte sur l'organisation du salon de Hambourg : stand, échantillons, brochures.
questions.takeaway: Trade fair = trade show = salon professionnel.

questions.prompt: What is suggested about this year's booth?
options: It is larger than last year's booth.
It is better located than last year's booth.
It has not been confirmed yet.
questions.evidence: Right next to the north entrance
questions.explanation: L'an dernier, le stand était au fond du hall 6 ; cette année il est juste à côté d'une entrée, donc mieux placé (plus de passage).
questions.traps: (D) est faux : l'emplacement vient d'être confirmé.
questions.takeaway: Foot traffic = passage, fréquentation.

questions.prompt: Why most likely did Ms. Silva book the courier well in advance?
options: To avoid a problem that happened previously
Because the brochures are not ready
Because the fair has been moved to an earlier date
questions.evidence: The shipment for last year's fair arrived a day late.
questions.explanation: Mme Martin rappelle que l'envoi de l'an dernier est arrivé en retard ; réserver une semaine avant l'installation évite de reproduire ce problème.
questions.takeaway: Pour un « why most likely », relie deux répliques consécutives.

questions.prompt: At 14:12, what does Mr. Kowalski most likely mean when he writes, "Then I think we're in good shape"?
options: He believes preparations are on track.
He is pleased with the booth's design.
He wants to exercise before the fair.
He thinks the brochures should be reprinted.
questions.evidence: Then I think we're in good shape.
questions.explanation: Après avoir vérifié le stand, les échantillons et les brochures, M. Kowalski conclut que tout est prêt : « we're in good shape » = nous sommes dans les temps / bien préparés.
questions.traps: (C) prend « shape » au sens physique (être en forme).
questions.takeaway: In good shape = en bonne voie, bien parti.

docs.title: Mercer Engineering — Project Coordinator (Toulouse office)
docs.body:
Mercer Engineering, a consulting firm specializing in renewable energy infrastructure, is seeking a project coordinator. Responsibilities include scheduling site visits, preparing progress reports for clients, and managing project budgets of up to €2 million.

Requirements:
• A degree in engineering, business, or a related field
• At least three years of project coordination experience
• Fluency in English and French; knowledge of Spanish is an advantage
• Willingness to travel up to 30 percent of the time

Send your CV and a cover letter to careers@mercer-eng.com by May 15. Interviews will take place during the week of May 26.

docs.subject: Application — Project Coordinator
docs.body:
Dear Hiring Manager,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Project Coordinator position advertised on your website. For the past four years, I have coordinated wind farm installation projects at Eolia Partners in Bordeaux, where I managed budgets of up to €3 million.

I am a native speaker of Portuguese and Spanish and work daily in French and English. I would also welcome the opportunity to travel, as I currently visit sites across southern France twice a month.

I will be attending a conference in Lisbon from May 27 to 29, but I am available for an interview on any other day.

Sincerely,
Inès Duarte

questions.prompt: What is NOT listed as a responsibility of the position?
questions.explanation: L'annonce cite la planification des visites de sites, les rapports d'avancement et la gestion des budgets. Le recrutement d'ingénieurs n'est pas mentionné.
questions.takeaway: Questions NOT : coche mentalement chaque option trouvée dans le texte.

questions.prompt: In the advertisement, the word "seeking" in paragraph 1, line 2, is closest in meaning to
questions.evidence: is seeking a project coordinator
questions.explanation: « Seek » = chercher : l'entreprise cherche un coordinateur de projet.
questions.takeaway: Seek = look for ; seeking candidates = recherche des candidats.

questions.prompt: What is suggested about Ms. Duarte?
options: She has managed smaller budgets than required.
She has more experience than the position requires.
questions.explanation: L'annonce exige au moins trois ans d'expérience ; Mme Duarte en a quatre. Elle a aussi géré des budgets de 3 M€, au-delà des 2 M€ du poste.
questions.traps: (C) est contredit (elle aimerait voyager). (D) : elle travaille à Bordeaux.
questions.takeaway: Documents multiples : compare les exigences du doc 1 aux informations du doc 2.

questions.prompt: Which qualification does Ms. Duarte have that the advertisement describes as an advantage?
questions.explanation: L'annonce indique que l'espagnol est un atout (« knowledge of Spanish is an advantage ») et Mme Duarte est de langue maternelle espagnole.
questions.traps: Le portugais n'est pas mentionné dans l'annonce, même s'il fait partie de ses compétences.
questions.takeaway: Advantage / asset / a plus = atout (non obligatoire).

questions.prompt: On which date would Ms. Duarte most likely be unable to attend an interview?
questions.explanation: Les entretiens ont lieu la semaine du 26 mai ; Mme Duarte est à Lisbonne du 27 au 29 mai. Le 28 mai est la seule date proposée qui tombe pendant sa conférence.
questions.traps: Le 30 mai est dans la semaine des entretiens mais après la conférence. Le 15 mai est la date limite de candidature.
questions.takeaway: Croise les dates des deux documents avant de répondre.

docs.title: Brightline Office Supplies — Invoice #BL-4471 — Customer: Hartwell Legal Services — September 3
docs.note: Subtotal: $852.00 — Orders over $500 qualify for free delivery. Payment due within 30 days.

docs.subject: Invoice BL-4471
docs.body:
Hello,

We received our order yesterday; thank you for the quick delivery. However, I noticed a problem with the invoice. We ordered six desk organizers, but only three were in the shipment, and the packing slip also lists three. Could you either send the remaining items or correct the invoice?

In addition, the toner cartridges we received are for the TX-80 model, not the TX-90 we ordered. Our printers are not compatible with the TX-80, so we will need to return them. Please let me know how you would like us to send them back.

Best regards,
Rachel Kim, Office Manager
Hartwell Legal Services

questions.prompt: Why did Ms. Kim write the e-mail?
options: To ask for a delivery date
To report problems with an order
questions.evidence: I noticed a problem with the invoice
questions.explanation: Mme Kim signale deux problèmes : des organiseurs manquants et des cartouches du mauvais modèle.
questions.takeaway: « However, I noticed a problem » introduit le vrai motif du message.

questions.prompt: How much was Hartwell Legal Services charged for items it did not receive?
questions.explanation: Six organiseurs ont été facturés (24,50 $ l'unité) mais seulement trois livrés : 3 × 24,50 $ = 73,50 $ facturés sans livraison.
questions.traps: 147 $ correspond aux six organiseurs ; 24,50 $ au prix d'un seul.
questions.takeaway: Questions de calcul : identifie la quantité manquante dans un document et le prix dans l'autre.

questions.prompt: What is indicated about the order?
options: It was delivered free of charge.
questions.explanation: Le sous-total est de 852 $ et la facture précise que les commandes de plus de 500 $ sont livrées gratuitement.
questions.traps: (A) est contredit par « thank you for the quick delivery ».
questions.takeaway: Les notes en bas de facture (conditions) servent souvent pour une question.

questions.prompt: What problem does Ms. Kim mention about the toner cartridges?
questions.evidence: the toner cartridges we received are for the TX-80 model, not the TX-90 we ordered
questions.explanation: Les cartouches reçues correspondent au modèle TX-80 au lieu du TX-90 commandé.
questions.takeaway: Not compatible = incompatible ; wrong model = mauvais modèle.

questions.prompt: What does Ms. Kim ask Brightline to provide?
options: A copy of the packing slip
questions.evidence: Please let me know how you would like us to send them back.
questions.explanation: Elle demande comment renvoyer les cartouches : ce sont des instructions de retour.
questions.takeaway: Send back = return = renvoyer.

docs.title: Digital Retail Summit — Day 2 Program (Thursday, March 12) — Riverside Convention Center

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
options: To request feedback on a session
To invite speakers to a summit
To announce a change to a schedule
questions.evidence: Please note one change to Thursday's program.
questions.explanation: L'e-mail annonce le déplacement de la session d'Elena Rossi : c'est une modification du programme.

questions.prompt: What will take place from 13:00 to 14:00 on March 12?

questions.prompt: According to the e-mail, what are attendees advised to do?
options: Arrive early for the panel discussion
Check out of their hotel by noon
questions.evidence: Attendees wishing to attend the afternoon panel are encouraged to arrive early.
questions.explanation: Le Grand Hall a un nombre de places limité : on conseille d'arriver tôt pour le panel de l'après-midi.
questions.takeaway: Be encouraged to = être invité à (conseil).

questions.prompt: In which room did Mr. Herrera most likely attend a session?
questions.explanation: M. Herrera a assisté à la session d'Elena Rossi, qui a été déplacée à 10 h 30 en salle A. Cohérent : il a manqué la session sur l'application de fidélité, programmée à la même heure.
questions.traps: La salle B était la salle prévue à l'origine (programme non mis à jour) : piège typique des triples documents.
questions.takeaway: Triple document : vérifie toujours si un document modifie l'information d'un autre.

questions.prompt: What does Mr. Herrera hope to receive?
options: An invitation to next year's summit
questions.evidence: I hope the slides will be shared with attendees.
questions.explanation: Il espère que les diapositives seront partagées : ce sont les supports de présentation.
questions.takeaway: Slides = presentation materials.

docs.title: Office Space for Rent — Canal Street Business Lofts
docs.body:
Three furnished units available from July 1 in a renovated 19th-century warehouse, five minutes' walk from Gare Centrale.

• Unit 2A: 45 m², 6 workstations, €1,450/month
• Unit 3B: 70 m², 10 workstations, private meeting room, €2,200/month
• Unit 4C: 95 m², 14 workstations, private meeting room, rooftop access, €2,950/month

All units include high-speed Internet, cleaning twice a week, and access to a shared kitchen. Minimum lease: 12 months. Contact Pauline Girard at Canal Street Properties to arrange a visit.

docs.subject: Visit request
docs.body:
Dear Ms. Girard,

I run a small design studio that currently has eight employees, and we plan to hire two more designers this autumn. We need a space with a room where we can meet clients privately, and our budget is up to €2,500 per month.

Would it be possible to visit the unit that best matches our needs on Friday afternoon? I would also like to know whether a lease of six months would be possible, as we may relocate to Paris next year.

Best regards,
Omar Benali, Benali Studio

docs.subject: RE: Visit request
docs.body:
Dear Mr. Benali,

Thank you for your interest. I would be happy to show you the unit on Friday at 3 P.M. Unfortunately, the owner does not accept leases shorter than the minimum period stated in our advertisement. However, the lease does allow tenants to move to a larger unit in the building without penalty if one becomes available.

I should also mention that the building's elevator will be replaced in July, so the upper floors will be accessible only by stairs for about two weeks.

Kind regards,
Pauline Girard

questions.prompt: What is true about all the units?
options: They have a private meeting room.
They can be rented for six months.
questions.evidence: cleaning twice a week
questions.explanation: Tous les bureaux incluent Internet, le ménage deux fois par semaine et une cuisine partagée.
questions.traps: Le toit et la salle de réunion ne concernent que certains bureaux. La durée minimale est de 12 mois.
questions.takeaway: « All units include » = information commune à tous.

questions.prompt: Which unit will Mr. Benali most likely visit?
options: A unit on the ground floor
questions.explanation: Il lui faut 10 postes (8 employés + 2 recrues), une salle de réunion privée et un loyer ≤ 2 500 €. Seul le 3B (10 postes, salle privée, 2 200 €) convient ; le 4C dépasse le budget.
questions.takeaway: Croise chaque critère (taille, équipement, budget) avec les options.

questions.prompt: What does Ms. Girard indicate about the lease?
options: It must last at least 12 months.
questions.explanation: Elle répond que le propriétaire n'accepte pas de bail plus court que la durée minimale de l'annonce, soit 12 mois. La demande de six mois est donc refusée.
questions.takeaway: « The minimum period stated in our advertisement » renvoie au doc 1 : Minimum lease 12 months.

questions.prompt: What is suggested about Benali Studio?
options: It is moving out of Paris.
It plans to increase its staff.
It works mainly with real estate clients.
questions.evidence: we plan to hire two more designers this autumn
questions.explanation: Le studio prévoit d'embaucher deux designers : l'effectif va augmenter.
questions.traps: (A) inverse l'information : le studio pourrait déménager À Paris.
questions.takeaway: Hire = recruter ; expand staff = augmenter l'effectif.

questions.prompt: According to Ms. Girard, what will happen in July?
options: A new tenant will move into Unit 4C.
Access to some floors will be limited.
questions.evidence: the upper floors will be accessible only by stairs for about two weeks
questions.explanation: Le remplacement de l'ascenseur rendra les étages supérieurs accessibles uniquement par l'escalier pendant environ deux semaines.
questions.takeaway: Only by stairs = accès limité.

sets.title: Communiqué + confirmation de commande + e-mail client

docs.title: Press Release — Velto Launches the Aria Smart Thermostat
docs.body:
BERLIN, 4 September — Velto GmbH today announced the launch of the Aria, a smart thermostat that learns users' daily routines and adjusts heating automatically. According to independent tests, households using the Aria reduced their heating costs by an average of 17 percent.

The Aria will be available in two versions: the Aria Basic (€129) and the Aria Plus (€179), which adds room-by-room temperature sensors and voice control. Customers who pre-order before 30 September will receive free installation by a certified technician, normally a €60 service.

docs.title: Velto Online Store — Order Confirmation
docs.body: Your order will be shipped from our Leipzig warehouse. You will receive an e-mail when your thermostat is on its way.

docs.subject: Order VT-20931
docs.body:
Hello,

My Aria arrived on Friday and the technician installed it yesterday. Everything works well, and I appreciate being able to set a different temperature in each room. However, the voice control feature does not respond to commands in French, even though your website states that French is supported. Could you tell me whether an update is planned?

Thank you,
Sophie Lambert

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the press release?
options: To report test results for competitors
questions.evidence: today announced the launch of the Aria
questions.explanation: Le communiqué annonce le lancement du thermostat Aria : il présente un nouveau produit.
questions.takeaway: Launch = lancement d'un produit.

questions.prompt: What is indicated about the Aria?
questions.evidence: reduced their heating costs by an average of 17 percent
questions.explanation: Les foyers équipés ont réduit leurs frais de chauffage de 17 % : « lower energy expenses » paraphrase « reduced heating costs ».
questions.traps: (A) : Leipzig est l'entrepôt d'expédition, pas forcément le lieu de fabrication.
questions.takeaway: Costs = expenses ; reduce = lower.

questions.prompt: How much did Ms. Lambert most likely pay for installation?
questions.explanation: Elle a commandé le 22 septembre, avant le 30 septembre : l'installation était offerte (« Installation: Included »).
questions.traps: 60 € est le prix normal de l'installation, sans l'offre de précommande.
questions.takeaway: Compare les dates : date de commande vs date limite de l'offre.

questions.prompt: Which version of the Aria did Ms. Lambert most likely buy?
options: The Aria Basic, because it was cheaper
The Aria Basic, because it includes voice control
The Aria Plus, because she can control each room's temperature
It cannot be determined from the documents.
questions.explanation: La confirmation ne précise pas la version, mais Mme Lambert règle la température pièce par pièce et utilise la commande vocale : ces fonctions n'existent que sur l'Aria Plus.
questions.traps: (D) est tentant car le bon de commande ne le dit pas, mais l'e-mail permet de le déduire.
questions.takeaway: Quand un document est incomplet, un autre permet souvent de déduire l'information.

questions.prompt: Why did Ms. Lambert contact Velto?
options: A feature does not work as advertised.
She wants to return the product.
questions.evidence: the voice control feature does not respond to commands in French
questions.explanation: La commande vocale ne répond pas en français alors que le site affirme que le français est pris en charge : une fonction ne marche pas comme annoncé.
questions.takeaway: As advertised = comme annoncé ; supported = pris en charge.
